newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian foreign debt rises in Dec qtr.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian foreign debt rises in Dec qtr.

text.p: Australia's net foreign debt rose to A$202.367 billion in the December quarter from A$196.042 billion in the September quarter (revised from A$191.194 billion), the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
This compared with net debt of A$186.419 billion a year earlier.
Gross foreign debt rose to A$248.453 billion from A$240.517 billion in the September quarter (revised from A$241.235 billion) compared with A$231.460 billion a year earlier, the bureau said.
Net Foreign Debt Dec Qtr 96 Sept Qtr 96 Dec Qtr 95
The Bureau said the ratio of net foreign debt to GDP at the end of the December quarter was 40.3 percent, up from 39.6 percent in the September quarter.
